_comment: CorridorKey model manifest. Each entry describes one weight file stored in Cloudflare R2. The downloader fetches presigned URLs from the license server at runtime — weights are never bundled. sha256 and size_bytes are TODO placeholders; fill in once final weights are locked.

models.name: CorridorKey Engine
models.description: Primary CorridorKey matting model (Niko's trained weights). Required by all host adapters.

models.name: SAM 2.1 Hiera Base Plus
models.description: Segment Anything Model 2.1 — base-plus variant. Higher accuracy, larger memory footprint. Preferred on machines with >= 8 GB VRAM.
models.variant_note: Choose one SAM 2.1 variant. base_plus = higher quality, more VRAM.

models.name: SAM 2.1 Hiera Small
models.description: Segment Anything Model 2.1 — small variant. Lower VRAM requirement (~4 GB). Suitable for machines without a high-end GPU.
models.variant_note: Choose one SAM 2.1 variant. small = lower VRAM, slightly lower quality.
